systems.name: 5.1 Heinum Slope Conversion
systems.notes: Witchaven uses sloped floors/ceilings via heinum. BUILD2UDMF already has slope plane math. Verify all slopes are correctly translated to UDMF plane equations.
tasks: Test every sloped sector in Witchaven maps
Ensure slope collision works in GZDoom

systems.name: 5.2 Z-Scale & Floor Alignment
systems.notes: Build's Z coordinates use different scale than Doom. Ensure the Z divisor (default 512) produces correct relative heights for all maps. Floor zeroing must not break multi-level areas.
tasks: Determine optimal Z-scale per game (Witchaven vs TekWar)
Implement per-game preset for Z divisor
Test all maps for correct floor/ceiling heights

systems.name: 5.3 BSP & Collision Mesh
systems.notes: GZDoom uses a node builder for collision. Ensure the generated UDMF has no self-intersecting linedefs or invalid sector references that break node building.
tasks: Run internal node builder on all converted maps
Check for 'Map has no nodes' errors
Fix overlapping linedefs or incorrect sidedefs
